items.title_cn: D-二聚体/淋巴细胞比值与急性胰腺炎严重程度的相关性：一项横断面研究
items.title_en: Association of D-dimer/Lymphocyte ratio with severity in acute pancreatitis: a cross-sectional study
items.abstract_cn: D-二聚体/淋巴细胞比值（DLR）反映凝血激活和免疫状态，但其与急性胰腺炎（AP）严重程度的关系尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨DLR与AP严重程度之间的关联。本横断面研究纳入2024年2月至2025年4月期间在江苏大学附属人民医院消化内科收治的285例成人AP患者。根据计算机断层扫描严重程度指数将疾病严重程度分为轻症急性胰腺炎（MAP）和中重症/重症急性胰腺炎（MSAP/SAP）。DLR计算为D-二聚体除以淋巴细胞计数，并经对数转换后记为LogDLR。采用Logistic回归和限制性立方样条（RCS）分析评估LogDLR与MSAP/SAP之间的关联。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析比较了LogDLR、NLR、PLR和CLR的判别性能；使用最大约登指数确定最佳截断值。在285例患者中，202例被归类为MAP，83例为MSAP/SAP。随着LogDLR升高，年龄、C反应蛋白、D-二聚体和住院时间呈上升趋势，而淋巴细胞计数下降。单因素分析显示，LogDLR与AP严重程度呈正相关（OR = 2.81，95%CI：1.70–4.66，P < 0.001）。在校正性别、年龄、体重指数、高血压和糖尿病后，该关联仍具有显著性（OR = 3.33，95%CI：1.90–5.81，P < 0.001），进一步校正甘油三酯、总胆固醇和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇后仍显著（OR = 3.45，95%CI：1.95–6.07，P < 0.001）。与最低四分位数组相比，Q4组患者发生MSAP/SAP的风险仍显著升高（模型1：Q4：OR = 4.21，95%CI：1.94–9.12，P < 0.001；模型2：Q4：OR = 5.34，95%CI：2.31–12.35，P < 0.001；模型3：Q4：OR = 5.57，95%CI：2.36–13.15，P < 0.001；均P < 0.001）。RCS分析显示存在总体关联（P < 0.001），但无统计学显著的非线性（P = 0.065）。LogDLR对MSAP/SAP的判别能力最高，AUC为0.68（95%CI：0.61–0.75）。较高的DLR与MSAP/SAP风险增加独立相关。尽管其判别性能中等，但DLR作为一种易于获取的标志物，可补充现有的严重程度评估，用于AP患者的早期风险分层。
items.abstract_en: The D-dimer/lymphocyte ratio (DLR) reflects coagulation activation and immune status, but its association with the severity of acute pancreatitis (AP) remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between DLR and AP severity. This cross-sectional study included 285 adult patients with AP admitted to the Department of Gastroenterology, Affiliated People’s Hospital of Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang, China, between February 2024 and April 2025. Disease severity was classified according to the computed tomography severity index as mild acute pancreatitis (MAP) or moderately severe/severe acute pancreatitis (MSAP/SAP). DLR was calculated as D-dimer divided by lymphocyte count and was log-transformed as LogDLR. Logistic regression and restricted cubic spline (RCS) analyses were used to assess the association between LogDLR and MSAP/SAP. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis compared the discriminatory performance of LogDLR, NLR, PLR, and CLR; Optimal cut-off values were determined using the maximum Youden index. Among the 285 patients, 202 were classified as MAP and 83 as MSAP/SAP. As LogDLR increased, age, C-reactive protein, D-dimer, and length of hospital stay showed increasing trends, whereas lymphocyte count decreased. Univariate analysis showed that LogDLR was positively associated with AP severity (OR = 2,81, 95%CI: 1.70–4.66, P < 0.001). This association remained significant after adjustment for sex, age, body mass index, hypertension, and diabetes (OR = 3.33, 95%CI: 1.90–5.81, P < 0.001), and further adjustment for, triglycerides, total cholesterol, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (OR = 3.45, 95%CI: 1.95–6.07, P < 0.001). Compared with the lowest quartile, the risk of MSAP/SAP in patients classified within group Q4 was remained significantly elevated (model 1: Q4: OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.94–9.12, P < 0.001, model 2: Q4: OR = 5.34, 95% CI: 2.31–12.35, P < 0.001, model 3: Q4: OR = 5.57, 95% CI: 2.36–13.15, P < 0.001); all P < 0.001). The RCS analysis showed an overall association ( P < 0.001) without statistically significant nonlinearity ( P = 0.065). LogDLR showed the highest discriminatory ability for MSAP/SAP, with an AUC of 0.68 (95% CI: 0.61–0.75). Higher DLR was independently associated with greater odds of MSAP/SAP. Although its discriminatory performance was modest, DLR may complement established severity assessments as a readily available marker for early risk stratification in patients with AP.
items.summary_cn: Higher D-dimer/lymphocyte ratio (DLR) was independently associated with greater odds of moderately severe or severe acute pancreatitis (MSAP/SAP), with an AUC of 0.68, suggesting DLR may complement established severity assessments for early risk stratification.

items.title_cn: 高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎新型动态亚表型的早期预测：多中心队列研究
items.title_en: Early prediction of novel dynamic subphenotypes in acute pancreatitis with hypertriglyceridemia: a multicenter cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 随着全球代谢性疾病负担的不断加重，高甘油三酯血症相关性急性胰腺炎（AP-HTG）的患病率显著升高。然而，初始甘油三酯升高水平与不良临床结局之间并无严格的相关性。因此，本研究旨在识别反映内在病理生理状态的新型动态亚表型，并构建早期预测模型。临床病理学数据来源于MIMIC-IV数据库（n=344，开发队列）、eICU-CRD数据库（n=173，外部验证队列）以及独立的本中心队列（n=319，实用性验证队列）。采用基于分组的多元轨迹模型（GBMTM）对7天白细胞和钙离子轨迹进行分析，以识别新型亚表型。在评估多种机器学习算法后，基于入院当日指标，利用Boruta、LASSO和逻辑回归建立了最优早期预测模型。共识别出四种新型动态亚表型，其中重度高炎症型（C3）和脂毒性低钙型（C4）亚表型携带持续性器官衰竭和多器官功能障碍综合征的显著独立风险。此外，构建了包含白细胞、钙离子、淋巴细胞、白蛋白、血小板和红细胞压积的早期逻辑回归预测模型。该模型在开发队列（0.924）和外部验证队列（0.933）中均取得了较高的宏平均AUC值。本中心队列的实用性验证进一步证实了该模型在有效识别高危亚表型方面的应用价值。为增强模型的可解释性和临床实用性，本研究应用了SHAP分析，并将模型部署为免费的网络计算器以及专门针对C4亚表型设计的列线图。本研究识别出四种新型AP-HTG动态亚表型，并基于入院当日指标构建了经多中心验证的早期预测模型，有助于早期风险分层和个体化临床决策。
items.abstract_en: Concomitant with the escalating global burden of metabolic disorders, acute pancreatitis with hypertriglyceridemia (AP-HTG) has become highly prevalent. However, the initial triglyceride elevation does not strictly correlate with adverse clinical outcomes. Therefore, we aimed to identify novel dynamic subphenotypes reflecting the intrinsic pathophysiological state and develop an early prediction model. Clinicopathological data were collected from MIMIC-IV ( n = 344, development), eICU-CRD ( n = 173, external validation), and an independent local cohort ( n = 319, pragmatic validation). Group-based multi-trajectory modeling (GBMTM) of 7-day white blood cell and calcium trajectories was utilized to identify novel subphenotypes. After evaluating multiple machine-learning algorithms, an optimal early prediction model was established using Boruta, LASSO, and logistic regression based on admission-day indicators. Four novel dynamic subphenotypes were identified, with the Severe-Hyperinflammatory (C3) and Lipotoxic-Hypocalcemic (C4) subphenotypes carrying substantially increased independent risks for persistent organ failure and multiple organ dysfunction syndrome. Furthermore, an early logistic regression prediction model comprising white blood cells, calcium, lymphocytes, albumin, platelets, and hematocrit was developed. This model achieved high macro-average AUCs in the development (0.924) and external validation (0.933) cohorts. Pragmatic validation in the local cohort further confirmed its utility in effectively identifying high-risk subphenotypes. To enhance interpretability and clinical utility, SHAP analysis was applied, and the model was deployed as a free web-based calculator and a nomogram specifically designed for the C4 subphenotype. This study identified four novel dynamic AP-HTG subphenotypes and developed a multicenter-validated early prediction model using admission-day indicators. It facilitates early risk stratification and individualized clinical decision-making.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过多中心队列识别出四种急性胰腺炎伴高甘油三酯血症的新型动态亚表型，其中两种亚表型显著增加持续性器官衰竭和MODS风险，并基于入院指标构建了早期预测模型。

items.title_cn: 胰十二指肠切除术后急性胰腺炎与临床相关术后胰瘘的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Association of postoperative acute pancreatitis with clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula after pancreaticoduodenectomy: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了胰十二指肠切除术后急性胰腺炎与临床相关术后胰瘘的关联，属于胰腺外科并发症领域，与用户关注的胰腺炎诊治有较强相关性，但非直接针对内科或内镜治疗。

items.title_cn: 囊性纤维化携带者血清脂肪酶正常的急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Acute Pancreatitis With a Normal Serum Lipase in a Cystic Fibrosis Carrier
items.abstract_cn: 我们讨论了一例年轻成年男性病例，其影像学检查确诊为急性胰腺炎，但整个病程中血清脂肪酶始终正常，并最终确认其为囊性纤维化（CF）基因携带者。我们探讨了脂肪酶在急性胰腺炎诊断中的敏感性，并考虑了在存在异常囊性纤维化跨膜传导调节因子（CFTR）基因的情况下，腺泡细胞损伤如何可能导致急性胰腺炎患者出现正常脂肪酶水平。本病例的独特之处在于描述了一位携带单个CF基因的患者出现急性胰腺炎但脂肪酶正常的情况。
items.abstract_en: We discuss a case of a young adult male presenting with radiologically confirmed acute pancreatitis, with a normal serum lipase throughout, confirmed to be a cystic fibrosis (CF) carrier. We discuss the sensitivity of lipase in acute pancreatitis and consider how acinar cell damage may lead to a normal lipase in individuals presenting with acute pancreatitis in the presence of an abnormal cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene. This case is unique in describing acute pancreatitis with a normal lipase in a patient with a single CF gene.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一名囊性纤维化携带者出现放射学确诊的急性胰腺炎，但血清脂肪酶始终正常，并探讨了CFTR基因异常可能导致脂肪酶正常的机制。

items.title_cn: 碎裂QRS波与系统性免疫炎症指数在急性胰腺炎中的预后价值
items.title_en: Prognostic Value of Fragmented QRS and Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index in Acute Pancreatitis

items.abstract_en: Aim: To investigate the association between fragmented QRS (fQRS) on electrocardiography and the Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII) with disease severity in patients with acute pancreatitis (AP).Methods: This retrospective observational study included 92 patients diagnosed with AP between January 2022 and December 2024. Clinical, laboratory, and electrocardiographic data at admission were analyzed. SII was calculated as platelet count × (neutrophil/lymphocyte). Severe AP was defined as a BISAP score ≥3. Patients were compared according to the presence or absence of fQRS. Multivariable logistic regression analysis was conducted including age, SII, and fQRS. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis was used to evaluate the predictive performance of SII.Results: Fragmented QRS was detected in 18 patients (19.6%). items.summary_cn: 该研究发现急性胰腺炎患者中碎裂QRS波（fQRS）与全身免疫炎症指数（SII）及BISAP评分显著相关，提示fQRS可能作为评估AP严重程度的辅助指标。

items.title_cn: 覆膜金属支架的透壁侧孔不减少胆管堵塞或胆囊炎：单中心研究
items.title_en: Transmural side holes in covered metal stents do not reduce bile duct occlusion or cholecystitis: a single center study
items.abstract_cn: 背景与研究目的：全覆膜自膨式金属支架（FCSEMS）用于治疗胆管狭窄。带有透壁侧孔的FCSEMS可能有利于胆囊管引流，从而降低胆囊炎风险，并影响支架移位、堵塞等其他支架相关不良事件。本研究比较了首次置入带或不带透壁侧孔FCSEMS的胆管狭窄患者中，支架早期堵塞和急性胆囊炎的发生率。患者与方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入2022年4月至2025年4月期间因恶性或良性肝外胆管狭窄接受内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）并置入FCSEMS的成人患者。主要结局为胆管支架早期堵塞。次要结局为胆囊完整的患者中急性胆囊炎的发生情况。结果：在符合入组标准的219例患者中，57例（26%）置入带侧孔支架。带透壁侧孔组支架早期堵塞率（12%）与无侧孔组（11%）相似（HR 1.02，95% CI 0.42–2.43，p = 0.96）。在胆囊完整的患者中（n=129），带侧孔组急性胆囊炎发生率（6%）与无侧孔组（4.8%）相似（HR 1.01，95% CI 0.22–4.5，p = 0.99）。结论：在这项初步的单中心回顾性研究中，与无侧孔FCSEMS相比，带侧孔FCSEMS并未降低胆管支架早期堵塞或急性胆囊炎的发生率。
items.abstract_en: Background and Study Aims Fully covered, self-expandable metal stents (FCSEMS) are used to treat biliary strictures. FCSEMS with transmural side holes may facilitate cystic duct drainage to mitigate risk of cholecystitis and impact other stent-related adverse events such as migration and occlusion. This study compared rates of premature stent occlusion and acute cholecystitis among patients with biliary strictures who underwent first-time placement of a FCSEMS with or without transmural side holes. Patient and Methods This was a retrospective cohort study of adults who underwent endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) with FCSEMS between April 2022 to April 2025 for malignant or benign extrahepatic bile duct strictures. The primary outcome was premature bile duct occlusion. The secondary outcome was acute cholecystitis among patients with an intact gallbladder. Results Among 219 patients meeting enrollment criteria, 57 (26%) had side holes. The rate of premature stent occlusion was similar with transmural side holes (12%) vs. without (11%, HR 1.02, 95% CI 0.42-2.43, p = 0.96). Among patients with an intact gallbladder (n=129), acute cholecystitis rates were similar with side holes (6%) or without (4.8%, HR 1.01, 95% CI 0.22-4.5, p = 0.99). Conclusions In this preliminary single center retrospective study, FCSEMS stents with side holes did not reduce rates of premature bile duct stent occlusion or acute cholecystitis compared to FCSEMS without side holes.
items.summary_cn: 该单中心回顾性研究显示，带跨壁侧孔的覆膜金属支架在胆管狭窄患者中并未降低支架过早闭塞或急性胆囊炎的发生率，与无侧孔支架相比无显著差异。

items.title_cn: 妊娠期原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进致高钙危象及急性胰腺炎一例
items.title_en: [Primary hyperparathyroidism in pregnancy resulting in hypercalcemic crisis and acute pancreatitis: A case report].
items.abstract_cn: 原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症（PHPT）是由甲状旁腺过度分泌甲状旁腺激素所致。妊娠期首次发现的PHPT极为罕见，对母体和胎儿均有严重不良影响。本文报道一例妊娠合并PHPT、高钙危象及急性胰腺炎的病例。患者为30岁女性，孕32周，表现为进行性加重的腹痛和呕吐，持续4天。入院时实验室检查显示血清总钙显著升高至3.56 mmol/L，甲状旁腺激素（PTH）水平为388.6 ng/L（正常参考范围为15～65 ng/L）。影像学检查证实存在急性胰腺炎、左肾结石、右肾积水，以及右甲状腺叶下极一枚可疑囊实性肿块，大小约2.1 cm × 2.0 cm × 1.2 cm。由于病情迅速恶化并出现高钙危象，行急诊剖宫产术，娩出一名存活早产男婴，出生体重2 400 g，身长45 cm。新生儿初始血清钙为3.08 mmol/L，出生后不久发生数次低钙性惊厥，需入住新生儿重症监护室。产后，母体接受了积极的静脉液体复苏、皮下注射降钙素及静脉双膦酸盐治疗。值得注意的是，产后其血清PTH水平显著下降，波动于48.91～53.08 ng/L之间。这一自发下降可能归因于急性胰腺炎发作期间有效循环血容量减少以及甲状旁腺腺瘤的部分缺血性坏死。产后第47天，患者成功接受了直径约3 cm的右下甲状旁腺腺瘤手术切除。切除标本的病理学检查确诊了诊断，并显示局灶性血管增生和充血、间质纤维化伴玻璃样变性及含铁血黄素沉积。甲状旁腺切除术后，其血清钙和PTH水平迅速恢复正常并保持稳定。术后9个月随访时，母亲完全无症状，生化指标正常，婴儿生长发育良好。临床医生应警惕妊娠期PHPT的存在，尤其是在备孕期和妊娠早期，应监测血钙水平并及早采取预防措施，以避免并发症和不良妊娠结局。
items.abstract_en: Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) is caused by excessive production of parathyroid hormone by the parathyroid gland. PHPT discovered for the first time during pregnancy is extremely rare and has serious adverse effects on both the mother and the fetus. This article reports a case of pregnancy complicated by PHPT, hypercalcemic crisis, and acute pancreatitis. The patient was a 30-year-old woman at 32 weeks of gestation who presented with a four-day history of progressive abdominal pain and vomiting. Laboratory evaluation on admission revealed a markedly elevated serum total calcium of 3.56 mmol/L and a parathyroid hormone (PTH) level of 388.6 ng/L, with the normal reference range being 15 to 65 ng/L. Imaging studies confirmed the presence of acute pancreatitis, left nephrolithiasis, right hydronephrosis, and a suspicious cystic-solid mass at the lower pole of the right thyroid lobe measuring 2.1 cm × 2.0 cm × 1.2 cm. Due to rapid clinical deterioration and the development of a hypercalcemic crisis, an emergency cesarean section was performed, resulting in the delivery of a live premature male infant with a birth weight of 2 400 g and a length of 45 cm. The neonate's initial serum calcium was 3.08 mmol/L, and several episodes of hypocalcemic seizures occurred shortly after birth, necessitating admission to the neonatal intensive care unit. Postpartum, the mother was managed with aggressive intravenous fluid resuscitation, subcutaneous calcitonin, and intravenous bisphosphonate therapy. Notably, her serum PTH level decreased substantially after delivery, ranging from 48.91 to 53.08 ng/L. This spontaneous decline was likely attributable to reduced effective circulating blood volume during the episode of acute pancreatitis and partial ischemic necrosis of the parathyroid adenoma. At 47 days postpartum, the patient underwent successful surgical resection of a right inferior parathyroid adenoma measuring approximately 3 cm in diameter. Pathological examination of the resected specimen confirmed the diagnosis and revealed focal vascular proliferation and congestion, interstitial fibrosis with hyaline degeneration, and hemosiderin deposition. Following parathyroidectomy, her serum calcium and PTH levels normalized rapidly and remained stable. At the 9-month follow-up visit, the mother was completely asymptomatic with normal biochemical parameters, and the infant demonstrated appropriate growth and development. Clinicians should be vigilant about the presence of PHPT during pregnancy, especially during preconception and early pregnancy, monitoring blood calcium levels and taking preventive measures early to avoid complications and adverse pregnancy outcomes.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了妊娠期原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进导致高钙危象和急性胰腺炎的罕见情况，患者产后血钙及PTH水平自发下降，最终通过手术切除甲状旁腺腺瘤后生化指标恢复正常，母婴结局良好。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
